subject: Conversation throttle observed - action plan & temporary mitigations
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus-retail.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@nimbus-retail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: Slow streaming responses across storefront chat - urgent

Hi Stephanie,

We started seeing elevated end-to-end latency for streaming chat responses around 05:30 PDT this morning. Customers report pauses where tokens arrive in 3-5s batches (previously near-real-time). This is impacting our checkout-assist flow.

I pulled an example trace and attached a short log snippet (nimbus-logs-0314.txt). The delays look most prominent for sessions that have been open longer than ~15 minutes. Can you confirm whether this is on your side or something in our integration? We’d like an ETA for mitigation and whether a temporary config change on our end can help.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Product Manager, Nimbus Retail
elena.soto@nimbus-retail.com

Attachment: nimbus-logs-0314.txt (text)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus-retail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Slow streaming responses across storefront chat - urgent

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for the log. I’m escalating this to our on-call infra and customer ops (cc’ed).

Immediate plan:
- We’ll triage telemetry now and share findings in ~45 mins.
- Temporary mitigations we can coordinate right away (no code deploy required):
  * Reduce streaming chunk_size to 256 tokens for your model route (expected to reduce inter-chunk batching pressure).
  * Enable non-stream fallback (polling every 250ms) for sessions longer than 10 minutes — this will avoid long-lived KV pressure on edges.
- We’ll propose a 1-hour maintenance window for a rolling restart of a small subset of edge shards if the mitigation doesn’t show improvement.

We’ll also provide a short post-incident follow-up with root cause and recommended long-term fixes.

Can you confirm whether you can accept the temporary config changes? If so, we’ll schedule them for the next 20 minutes.

—Stephanie
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Slow streaming responses across storefront chat - urgent

Quick triage summary from infra:
- Symptom: Elevated per-chunk enqueue latency on edge-shard-7a (us-west). Token emission for streaming requests shows >2s inter-chunk gaps under sustained sessions.
- Likely proximate cause: Suboptimal KV cache eviction pattern when session context > ~20k tokens; we’re seeing cache churn that forces repeated rehydrations and stalls chunk emission.
- Immediate mitigations we recommend (safe and reversible):
  1) Apply dynamic_chunk_sizing=on for Nimbus model route (this will shrink produced chunk size when backlog is detected). Expected improvement: 30-50% reduction in inter-chunk latency for affected sessions.
  2) Temporarily disable aggressive prefix caching for routes flagged as long-lived sessions (reduces eviction churn).
  3) If customer approves, schedule rolling restart of the three worker pods on edge-shard-7a to clear degraded state (non-disruptive to other shards).

I’ll prepare a compact telemetry bundle (attached: redwood-edge-metrics-20280321.png) and monitor after changes.

—Vivek
On-call Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus-retail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Slow streaming responses across storefront chat - action plan confirmed

Hi Elena — thanks for confirming earlier access. Per Vivek’s triage we’ve prepared a short, reversible action plan we can execute immediately. Please reply ACK to proceed or request we hold: 

Planned steps (start within 20 minutes once you ACK):
1) Apply dynamic_chunk_sizing=on for your model route (no restart). Expected: faster emission with slightly smaller chunks.
2) Reduce configured streaming chunk_size to 256 tokens for sessions marked as long-lived. Expected: lower per-chunk processing latency.
3) Enable non-stream fallback for sessions older than 10 minutes (customer-visible change: streaming switches to polling-based responses for those sessions; still returns full content).
4) Monitor real-time telemetry for 60 minutes. If improvements are not observed, schedule rolling restart of three worker pods on edge-shard-7a during the 1-hour maintenance window at 10:30–11:30 PDT.

We’ll update your status every 15 minutes and follow with a concise postmortem and remediation plan. As a gesture of goodwill given the impact to checkout flows, we’ll apply a usage credit to the March invoice; details in the postmortem.

If you approve, reply with “ACK — apply mitigations now”.

Thanks,
Stephanie
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbus-retail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@nimbus-retail.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Slow streaming responses across storefront chat - action plan confirmed

ACK — apply mitigations now.

Please confirm when the dynamic chunk sizing is live and whether we should expect any brief connection resets. We will standby for the rolling restart window if needed.

Also please include a postmortem with recommended long-term fixes and timeline — our security and ops teams will need that for our incident review.

Appreciate the fast response.
Elena
